summary: Complete the host contract with the aider and Copilot hosts

delivery.outcome: aider and GitHub Copilot load the same fail-closed contract as Claude Code, Gemini and Cursor, and adopters receive both files digest-pinned like every other host file.
nonGoals: Adding a host whose instruction file the tool does not load by itself.
Changing the hook, the validator or any check name.
Adopting the new files anywhere; adoption stays an explicit per-repository transaction.

architecture.decision: Declare both hosts in agent-hosts.json and ship their files through the same managed package channel, so the validator requires them and GOV-SYNC-001 pins them with no new mechanism. aider is configured with auto-commits disabled so the tool cannot create a commit the hook has not seen.
interfaceChanges: the aider and Copilot hosts join the contract, so the validator requires their files
adopters receive .aider.conf.yml and .github/copilot-instructions.md as managed files
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; adopters keep their current managed digests.

validation.evidence: GOV-AGENT-HOST-PASS with six declared hosts present.
The fixture derives its host files from the contract, so both new hosts are exercised without editing the test.
Both new package sources adopt and lock.
